summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on July 14, 2026, reporting the purchase of 7,000,000 of its own ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 110.9025 pence per share. These purchases are part of an existing share buyback programme announced on January 30, 2026, and executed under instructions issued on January 29, 2026. The repurchased shares are intended to be cancelled. This is an issuer ordinary-course share buyback under market abuse regulations, representing capital return to shareholders. The filing does not involve a tender offer or other special situation; it is a routine buyback disclosure. No special committee or advisor is noted. The transaction reflects ongoing capital allocation strategy; watch for future buyback pace and volume changes.
